subject: Kusoma / Reading

activities.learning_activity: (a) Identifying vowel sounds (a, e, i, o, u) in words
activities.assessment_criteria: Vowel sounds (a, e, i, o, u) are identified in words
suggested_resources: Flashcards and picture charts of items starting with vowels

activities.learning_activity: (b) Combining vowel sounds to form words (oa, au, ua)
activities.assessment_criteria: Vowel sounds are combined to form words (oa, au, ua)

activities.learning_activity: (c) Identifying consonant sounds (b, m, k, d, n); (l, t, p, s, f, j); (g, y, z, h, r, w, v, ch) in words
activities.assessment_criteria: Consonant sounds (b, m, k, d, n); (l, t, p, s, f, j); (g, y, z, h, r, w, v, ch) in words are identified

activities.learning_activity: (d) Identifying capital and small letters
activities.assessment_criteria: Capital and small letters are identified

activities.learning_activity: (e) Combining consonant and vowel sounds to form syllables
activities.assessment_criteria: Consonant and vowel sounds are combined to form syllables

activities.learning_activity: (f) Separating by pronouncing the consonant and vowel sounds that form syllables and the syllables that form words
activities.assessment_criteria: Consonant and vowel sounds forming syllables and syllables forming words are separated by pronunciation

activities.learning_activity: (g) Identifying sounds of consonant clusters (sh, th, mb, ny, ng, nd, kw, mw) in words
activities.assessment_criteria: Sounds of consonant clusters (sh, th, mb, ny, ng, nd, kw, mw) in words are identified

activities.learning_activity: (h) Combining sounds of consonant clusters (sh, th, mb, ny, ng, nd, kw, mw) and vowels to form syllables
activities.assessment_criteria: Sounds of consonant clusters (sh, th, mb, ny, ng, nd, kw, mw) are combined to form syllables

activities.learning_activity: (a) Correlating sounds and vowel letters (a, e, i, o, u) in texts
activities.assessment_criteria: Sounds and vowel letters (a, e, i, o, u) are correlated in texts
suggested_resources: Flashcards and charts of pictures and letters
videos with sounds and names of vowel letters

activities.learning_activity: (b) Correlating sounds and consonant letters (b, m, k, d, n); (l, t, p, s, f, j); (g, y, z, h, r, w, v, ch) in texts
activities.assessment_criteria: Sounds and consonant letters (b, m, k, d, n); (l, t, p, s, f, j); (g, y, z, h, r, w, v, ch) are correlated in texts

activities.learning_activity: (c) Correlating sounds and consonant cluster letters (sh, th, mb, ny, ng, nd, kw, mw) in texts
activities.assessment_criteria: Sounds and consonant cluster letters (sh, th, mb, ny, ng, nd, kw, mw) are correlated in texts

activities.learning_activity: (d) Combining consonant cluster letter sounds and vowels to read syllables in all groups (sh, th, mb, ny, ng, nd, kw, mw)
activities.assessment_criteria: Consonant cluster letter sounds and vowels are combined to read syllables in all groups (sh, th, mb, ny, ng, nd, kw, mw)

activities.learning_activity: (e) Combining syllables to read words
activities.assessment_criteria: Syllables are combined to read words

activities.learning_activity: (f) Separating by pronouncing individual sounds to form words
activities.assessment_criteria: Sounds are separated by pronouncing individual sounds to form words

activities.learning_activity: (g) Combining words to read sentences
activities.assessment_criteria: Words are combined to read sentences

activities.learning_activity: (a) Reading aloud a matched passage/story paying attention to correct pronunciation of words
activities.assessment_criteria: A matched passage/story has been read aloud paying attention to correct pronunciation of words
suggested_resources: pictures of various objects and recorded passages or stories

activities.learning_activity: (b) Reading aloud a matched passage/story at an appropriate speed (40 words per minute)
activities.assessment_criteria: A matched passage/story has been read aloud at an appropriate speed (40 words per minute)

activities.learning_activity: (c) Reading aloud a matched passage/story with expression and paying attention to punctuation marks (full stop, comma, question mark, and exclamation mark)
activities.assessment_criteria: A matched passage/story has been read aloud, with expression and paying attention to punctuation marks (full stop, comma, question mark, and exclamation mark)

activities.learning_activity: (a) Interpreting and explaining pictures
activities.assessment_criteria: Pictures are explained and interpreted correctly
suggested_resources: Flashcards and picture charts of various objects

activities.learning_activity: (b) Predicting the content of a passage/story accurately using pictures, the title of the passage/story, and selected vocabulary
activities.assessment_criteria: He/she has predicted the content of the passage/story using pictures, the title of the story, and selected vocabulary

activities.learning_activity: (c) Listening to a passage/story for comprehension
activities.assessment_criteria: The passage/story has been listened to for comprehension

activities.learning_activity: (a) Identifying sounds in words
activities.assessment_criteria: Sounds in words have been identified
suggested_resources: words and videos related to consonant cluster sounds and vowels to read syllables

activities.learning_activity: (b) Combining consonant cluster letter sounds (gh, ng’, nz, nj, sw, bw, gw, tw, dh, pw, vy, fy, my, ml, ky, py, ft, lw) and vowels to read syllables
activities.assessment_criteria: Consonant cluster letter sounds (gh, ng’, nz, nj, sw, bw, gw, tw, dh, pw, vy, fy, my, ml, ky, py, ft, lw) and vowels have been combined and syllables have been read

activities.learning_activity: (c) Pronouncing words with consonant cluster syllables
activities.assessment_criteria: Words with consonant cluster syllables have been pronounced

activities.learning_activity: (d) Identifying the sounds that form words in sentences
activities.assessment_criteria: The sounds forming words in sentences have been identified

activities.learning_activity: (a) Combining sounds of double-consonant clusters and vowels to form syllables (gh, ng’, nz, nj, sw, bw, gw, tw, dh, pw, vy, fy, my, ml, ky, py, ft, lw) and introducing consonant clusters in loan words (bl, sp, sk, pt, st, ks, kt, pl, al, ar)
activities.assessment_criteria: Sounds of double-consonant clusters and vowels have been combined to form syllables (gh, ng’, nz, nj, sw, bw, gw, tw, dh, pw, vy, fy, my, ml, ky, py, ft, lw) and consonant clusters in loan words (bl, sp, sk, pt, st, ks, kt, pl, al, ar) have been introduced
suggested_resources: words and videos with double-consonant cluster sounds and vowels

activities.learning_activity: (b) Combining syllables to read words with three consonants and vowels (njwa, nywe, shwa, ngwa, mbwe, ndwa, ng’we)
activities.assessment_criteria: Syllables have been combined to read words with three consonants and vowels (njwa, nywe, shwa, ngwa, mbwe, ndwa, ng’we)

activities.learning_activity: (c) Combining words to read sentences
activities.assessment_criteria: Words have been combined to read sentences

activities.learning_activity: (a) Reading a leveled passage/story with confidence while observing correct word pronunciation
activities.assessment_criteria: A leveled passage/story has been read with confidence while observing correct word pronunciation

activities.learning_activity: (b) Reading a leveled passage/story at an appropriate speed (50 words per minute)
activities.assessment_criteria: A leveled passage/story has been read at an appropriate speed (50 words per minute)

activities.learning_activity: (c) Reading a leveled passage/story with confidence, expression, and attention to punctuation marks (full stop, comma, question mark, exclamation mark)
activities.assessment_criteria: A leveled passage/story has been read with confidence, expression, and attention to punctuation marks (full stop, comma, question mark, exclamation mark)

activities.learning_activity: (d) Reading a simple passage/story aloud
activities.assessment_criteria: A simple passage/story has been read aloud

activities.learning_activity: (a) Interpreting and explaining events (Arranging and reading sentences following the correct sequence of events, reading sentences with the correct sequence, arranging and reading mixed-up sentences to bring out a logical flow)
activities.assessment_criteria: Events have been interpreted and explained (arranging and reading sentences following the correct sequence of events, reading sentences with the correct sequence, arranging and reading mixed-up sentences to bring out a logical flow)
suggested_resources: videos related to reading and listening for comprehension and recorded texts

activities.learning_activity: (b) Retelling a short text read using a logical sequence of events
activities.assessment_criteria: Short texts have been read using a logical sequence of events

activities.learning_activity: (c) Listening to a simple text for comprehension
activities.assessment_criteria: A simple text has been listened to for comprehension

activities.learning_activity: (d) Reading a simple text for comprehension
activities.assessment_criteria: A simple text has been read for comprehension

translation_note: English rendering of the Kiswahili TIE syllabus, for English-medium schools. Not TIE's own wording — see translation_of for the verbatim source.
